newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Jan 31.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Jan 31.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

-------- COMMENTS - Bunkers prices eased, following weaker cargo prices, traders said on Friday. Most traders said the market was very quiet with players winding down activities at the week's end and as the Chinese and Moslem festivities draws nearer. "The market is already slipping into a lull," said a trader. "Bunker quotes just eased in line with the softer cargo levels," he said.
